title: S23 - invited second-class fixer (digit homoglyphs): measured NEGATIVE - subsumed by lex R1-R4
desc: t-5d1c invited 'a second class fixer for O/0 l/1 digit homoglyphs. Claim it.' Built the conservative forward-only fixer (mixed digit+letter token whose transliteration lowercases to vocab -> rewrite letters; upper and r4 case policies). Measured all 400 reads, v2+v3, plain+shipping: r4-policy is an exact identity on the shipping route (lex R3/R4 already does it, both directions of case); upper-policy nets +1 pooled on v2 but breaks 2 real items (easy-0030 v1olet, easy-0075 1vory) and is net -1 on v3. Verdict: no free lunch - the class is decided by the glyph, not by a rule; lex subsumes it. Evidence: reports/s23-homoglyph-fix.md + tools/homoglyph_fix.py (self-test). Small receipt PR, no wiring.
